description: Step 3 orchestrator policy: when the case must stop and ask the client instead of pushing UNKNOWN / CONFLICT downstream (spec §14, §15, §30, §31).

conflict.comment: A conflict is never resolved by picking one value. The case parks and both candidates are shown to the client.

next_question_templates.existing_protection.existing_insurance: 请确认客户目前已持有的商业保险（险种 + 保额）。若确实无法提供，请明确回答「未知」，我们将按 UNKNOWN 处理，不会替你假设。
next_question_templates.family_profile.age: 请提供客户的准确年龄（用于核保与费率判断）。
next_question_templates.financial_profile.annual_income: 请提供客户当前年收入（税前/税后请注明）。
